attribution.note: Marcus wrote and endorsed the sentence in his own commentary.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves his expressed uncertainty, ambiguous incident reference, and dates of earlier warnings. It does not assert either cause.

contract.note: The contract fairly avoids assigning an incident or knowledge scope that Marcus did not specify. A factual test would depend on those added interpretations.

reviews.rationale: The sentence expresses uncertainty about an ambiguously identified outage and leaves whose knowledge is described unspecified. It supplies no definite causal assertion to score. The empty evidence packet does not make this interpretive limitation a broken case.
